requirements.general_text: Bachelor’s Degree (Level 6, MQF): In a Related Field: Pass with a minimum CGPA of 2.50 Pass with a minimum CGPA of 2.00-2.50 may require an internal assessment. In a Non-Related Field: Pass with a minimum CGPA of 2.00 and relevant working experience may require an internal assessment. Pass with a minimum CGPA of 2.00 and without relevant working experience may require the completion of prerequisite courses. English Language Requirements (for International Students) MUET: Minimum 4.0 IELTS: Minimum 6.0 TOEFL: Ess Online: Minimum 8.5 iBT: Minimum 60 Pearson: Minimum 59 Linguaskill Online: Minimum 169 Admission via APEL (Accreditation of Prior Experiential Learning) For those without the required formal qualification, but with relevant work experience: Malaysian citizens aged 30 years or older Must possess at least STPM, A-level, Diploma, or an Equivalent qualification Must have relevant work experience. APEL provides an alternative entry method, allowing applicants to be assessed based on their prior learning and work experience for Master of Business Administration programmes
